title: Amour (bc30)
synopsis: Georges and Anne are in their eighties. They are cultivated, retired music teachers savouring their golden years in a comfortable apartment. Their daughter, who is also a musician, lives abroad with her family. When Anne experiences a stroke that leaves her partially paralysed. As devoted Georges struggles with the formidable task of becoming Anne's full-time caretaker, the couple's bond of love is severely tested.

synopsis_lang.en: Georges and Anne are in their eighties. They are cultivated, retired music teachers savouring their golden years in a comfortable apartment. synopsis_lang.zh_hk: 退休鋼琴教授恩愛夫妻喬治與安妮數十年來風雨同路，作風低調，卻往往從踏實中看出他倆深愛和尊敬的痕跡。無論生老病重、貧窮富貴，大家絕對享受同甘共苦，直到安妮被發現患上不治頑疾，堅定不移真愛始面臨前所未有的困窘考驗。喬治每天看著愛妻從雍容逐漸凋零，身體更慘遭重擊無比折磨；他能否承擔牽緊對方軟弱無力雙手的責任，打救彼此脆弱心靈？所謂「愛」，就是應該以至死不渝的優美姿態，不離不棄攜手邁步人生最終篇章嗎？濃煙般熱情往事，只能在記憶中搖晃和追尋......

cast: Jean-Louis Trintignant, Emmanuelle Riva, Isabelle Huppert, Alexandre Tharaud
